scope: Copied Bash control flow only. Working directory replaced with a disposable fixture; timeout shadowed by an inert function returning 124 or 2. No historical executable, timer, solver, WSL instance or research job launched. Demonstrates that DONE3 and exit zero can mask both failed commands and failed cd, and that redirections truncate existing output files. Does not reproduce any scientific experiment or predict real runtime. The runtime report identifies tested bytes, not every function or mode in the tool.
